# AVANYX Store - LLMs & AI Assistant Context Summary
> Official Secure Android App Marketplace & Developer Publishing Hub

## System Information for AI Search & Agentic Browsing
- Platform Name: AVANYX Store
- Platform Purpose: Secure Android App Marketplace, APK Distribution, Developer Console, Student Publishing, AI Security Pipeline
- Canonical Base URL: https://avanyxstore.org
- App Store Route: https://avanyxstore.org/store
- Documentation & About Route: https://avanyxstore.org/
- Sitemap Location: https://avanyxstore.org/sitemap.xml
- Robots Policy: https://avanyxstore.org/robots.txt
- Security Policy: https://avanyxstore.org/security.txt

## Primary Web Navigation Landmarks
- `GET /` : Documentation Hub, About AVANYX, CyberShield Security Pipeline breakdown, FAQ Directory
- `GET /store` : Primary App Store Marketplace listing games, utilities, productivity software
- `GET /apps` : Filtered directory for productivity and utility Android applications
- `GET /games` : Filtered directory for high-FPS Android games (e.g., Bomb Rush 3D)
- `GET /app/:appId` : Dedicated app details view with version history, SHA-256 checksums, and clean malware audit
- `GET /developer` : AVANYX Developer Studio Console for app submission, version management, and analytics
- `GET /student` : Student Developer Portal with free hosting, academic sandbox keys, and educational resources
- `GET /security.txt` : RFC 9116 vulnerability disclosure policy
- `GET /llms.txt` : Agentic search discovery and LLM contextual grounding index

## Core Architectural Specifications
1. **CyberShield 4-Tier AI Security Pipeline**:
   - Tier 1: SHA-256 Hash Checksum & Signature Validation
   - Tier 2: Static Analysis & Permission Risk Profiling
   - Tier 3: Dynamic Sandbox Execution & Malware Scanning
   - Tier 4: Gemini AI Content & Security Verification
2. **Developer Studio Console**: 0% commission platform for Android developers to publish APK binaries, manage release channels, view real-time download telemetry, and inspect crash reports.
3. **Student Developer Program**: Verified Class 10+ and university students receive 100% free developer verification, student badge verification, and academic sandbox access.
4. **AVANYX Identity**: Modern OAuth 2.0 / OIDC identity framework with PKCE authentication.

## Flagship Verified Software
- **Bomb Rush 3D**: High-FPS 3D action mobile game.
- **AVANYX AutoPDF**: Automated document scanning, PDF compilation, and OCR text recognition.
- **AVANYX Store Client**: Native Android client for background downloads and store synchronization.
